name: What is the typical process for implementing a topic cluster strategy for AI content?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for implementing a topic cluster strategy for AI content?

acceptedAnswer.text: Implementing a topic cluster strategy for AI content begins with identifying core pillar topics relevant to your AI solutions and target audience. Next, conduct thorough keyword research to uncover related sub-topics that can become cluster content. You then create a central pillar page that provides a comprehensive overview, and individual cluster pages that delve into specific aspects. Crucially, all cluster content must link back to the pillar page, and the pillar page should link to the cluster content, forming an interconnected structure. Finally, monitor performance and refine your content based on data.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves identifying pillar topics, researching sub-topics, creating comprehensive pillar pages and detailed cluster pages, interlinking them, and monitoring performance.
